scope: First large controlled batch from the 131 canonical records carrying reviewStatus=conflicting
policy: Preserve recalledAnswer and source wording. This batch classifies the conflict and defines the next verification action; it does not invent missing choices or force a verifiedAnswer where the retained item cannot support one.
